name: pixel_ovss_protocol_v0
role: Pixel-level open-vocabulary semantic segmentation evaluation of CTP-v1 and baselines; converts region-level semantic calibration into semantic segmentation without new proposal networks

dataset_status.Vaihingen: untouched_external_confirmation (predict hashes frozen before GT read)

region_proposal_source.rule: inherit first-paper SAM3 candidate masks (frozen); no new proposal network
region_proposal_source.love_da: first-paper candidate caches (candidate_cache npz/json, SAM3-driven) for the registered heldout images
region_proposal_source.vaihingen: runs/vaihingen_sam3_v0/candidates/*.npz (16 GT areas; user-authorized SAM3 rerun with all-positive image-level assumption)

semantic_assignment.rule: OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 quick-GELU region features + frozen prototypes; per-region class via method scores
semantic_assignment.visual_prototype: train-area SAM3 weak labels: L2 per region -> class mean -> L2

mask_fusion.overlap_resolution: per-pixel highest region score wins; ties broken by class id order; conflict margin 0.03 between region scores (from FusionCanvas)
mask_fusion.uncovered_pixels: pixels not covered by any candidate mask receive uncovered_label=255 (ignore)
mask_fusion.background_handling: no explicit background class in the 5/6-class vocabulary; uncovered=ignore; clutter (Vaihingen red) is ignore in GT
mask_fusion.semantic_map: uint8 label map per image assembled from per-region assigned classes and their masks

hash_binding: prediction files (scores, per-region class ids, semantic maps)

evaluation.partial_support: enumerate non-trivial support subsets (LoveDA 6 classes: 2^6=64; Vaihingen 5 classes: 2^5=32) OR fixed ratios 25/50/75% with seeds 42/43/44 pre-registered; subset lists saved before GT read
evaluation.H_aggregation: mean over subsets of per-subset H (mean(H_i))
evaluation.ignore_rule: uncovered/ignore pixels excluded from all metrics; same valid pixel set for all methods

pipeline_stages: load frozen SAM3 candidate masks per test image
encode region crops with frozen OpenAI CLIP (no re-encoding beyond frozen cache rules)
compute T_c, A_c, S_c^SCC, CTP decision per region (frozen formulas)
assign class to each candidate region per method
assemble semantic map via frozen FusionCanvas rules (overlap/uncovered/ignore)
persist per-method semantic maps + scores + config + hashes
compute pixel metrics, partial-support S/U/H, cluster bootstrap
